title: Raptor Suit
content: The CGI visual effects for the movie Jurassic Park received a lot of attention, but the animatronics were equally groundbreaking.(Link to video) In this archive video, one of the designers, John Rosengrant recalls how the people at Stan Winston Studios were able to build raptor suits around him andMark 'Crash' McCreery.StanWinstonSchool.comPreviously on GJ:Jurassic Park Set Visit
